source.name: Front Office Sports – 'MLB Jersey Patch Market Warming Up As Season Approaches'
source.note: The Kroger patch deal was announced in February 2023; the Blinkfire 2026 list still names it as the Reds' patch.
source.quote: The Cincinnati Reds inked a deal with Kroger worth $5 million annually, according to Sports Business Journal, to put the grocery store chain's logo on the team's uniforms.
